_doc: en-us localization for expEvent_producer_interview.json (same folder convention).

en-us.exp_event_erav_producer_interview_ongoin: $names$ waits under the fill lights for the "final interview" to begin.
en-us.exp_event_erav_producer_interview_result: $names$ is called into the room with the camera set up.
en-us.event_erav_producer_interview_01:
The man who calls himself the president paces around $victim.name$, blocking a scene like a director.
"The lighting is wrong. No matter - just smile. Come on, smile. ...Good, that works. This face can debut."
He takes off his jacket, drapes it over a chair, and rolls his neck. "So - the final interview begins."
en-us.event_erav_producer_interview_02:
He doesn't do the undressing himself; he does "styling direction".
"Keep this layer, take off the one under it. Undo all the buttons - the concept is 'innocent', so the innocent parts stay. ...Good. Cut. Hold that exact pose."
en-us.event_erav_producer_interview_03:
"Now, camera-presence practice." He raises his phone sideways.
"Eyes on the lens. Don't dodge, a dodge ruins the take. ...Yes, yes, just like that, look at me. Keep the tears too, don't wipe them. That's what the audience eats up."
en-us.event_erav_producer_interview_04:
"Cut - that expression just now was incredible. Once more, slower this time."
He stares at her on his screen, grinning like he's struck a vein of ore.
"Ohh, talent. This is pure talent. Sign with our agency - your name on the cover."
en-us.event_erav_producer_interview_05:
"The examiner enters." Smiling, he spreads her legs.
"Voice! I need voice! Not the pained kind - yes, that note, hold it, hold it -"
He keeps critiquing while he moves, fingers tapping tempo on her hip. "The pitch deck will read: 'Rookie - Kiryu-gumi recommendation - debt-collector beauty.' ...Even I think that title sells."
en-us.event_erav_producer_interview_06:
"End of the take. Per industry rules -" he spends himself inside her, and only remembers the rest of the sentence a moment later.
"...Inside or outside was supposed to be your call. Never mind - on film, inside sells better."
He pockets the phone. "I'll send today's footage to your supervisor for review. After all - when the debt goes unpaid, he's the one who gets written down in value."
